content: Mudlet GMCP scripts consume data through raised gmcp.* events and the gmcp global table; sendGMCP can request modules/data such as Char.Skills.Get, but Mudlet notes most GMCP modules arrive automatically from server events and IRE/MCCP may need a follow-up blank send. registerAnonymousEventHandler can subscribe to GMCP events and returns an id for cleanup, with named handlers protecting against duplication in newer Mudlet versions.
